hero.subheadline: Fels Automation builds AI voice agents that handle incoming or outbound calls, capture orders, respond to enquiries, and keep your operations running smoothly — all within your existing workflows.

services.title: Inbound Voice Agents
services.description: Every call answered. Every detail captured. Our inbound AI agents handle enquiries, qualify leads, route callers to the right place, and log everything into your systems — automatically, 24/7

services.title: Outbound Voice Agents
services.description: Reach more prospects in a day than your team could in a week. Our outbound AI agents initiate conversations, qualify interest, handle common objections, and secure meetings — all without a single manual dial.

services.title: Call-Based Workflow Automation
services.description: Every phone call triggers the right action. From bookings and orders to confirmations and follow-ups — your systems stay updated automatically, with zero manual effort in between.

testimonials.quote: We weren't sure what to expect when we first integrated the AI system into our patient acquisition process — but the results spoke for themselves. Within just a few months, we saw a noticeable increase in new patient inquiries and bookings, without us having to lift a finger on the marketing side. The automation handles the follow-ups and outreach seamlessly, so our team can stay focused on what we do best: taking care of our patients. Honestly, it's one of the best decisions we've made for the growth of our clinic.
testimonials.author: — Melona Dent Clinic, Türkiye

testimonials.quote: We never imagined we could reconnect with thousands of customers in a single hour. Fels built an agent that transformed how our entire operation communicates — we can make 600 simultaneous calls.
testimonials.author: — Aslıhan Ecza Deposu, Türkiye

testimonials.quote: Since integrating the AI calling agent into our sales process, taking orders from pharmacies has never been smoother. The agent handles the calls, captures the orders accurately, and generates the dispatch invoices automatically — cutting out a lot of the manual work our team used to deal with daily. It's streamlined our entire operation and let us scale outreach without adding headcount.
testimonials.author: — Meicomed, Türkiye
